Our plates.

01 — Rosemary chicken Our signature

Rosemary Chicken Plate

Oven-baked half chicken, marinated in our signature Mediterranean spice blend with fresh rosemary, finished in 100% extra-virgin olive oil.

Served with your choice of two sides.

Order
02 — Salmon

Scottish Salmon Plate

Scottish salmon, filleted in-house daily, grilled with seasonal vegetables, extra-virgin olive oil, and fresh lemon.

Served with your choice of two sides.

Order
03 — Chicken shawarma

Chicken Shawarma Plate

Tender, thinly sliced chicken breast, grilled with white onions and a house Turkish spice blend.

Served with your choice of two sides.

Order
04 — Lamb shawarma

Lamb Shawarma Plate

Slow-cooked leg of lamb, marinated in a house Turkish spice blend and roasted until tender.

Served with your choice of two sides.

Order
05 — Falafel

Falafel Plate

Four house-made falafels served with your choice of three sides.

Many of our sides are vegan and gluten-free.
